results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and native crops of the face (two zoom levels), both hands (zoomed), the arms and torso, the lower body (brightened), each seal, the hunters at the opening, and all four corners (brightened, checking for signatures). This redraw answers the r02 reject. One humanlike spirit (nootaikok-c03): one head, two eyes and a closed mouth. The face is grave, weathered and dignified, with a steady gaze down at the viewer. There is no smile or smirk, and it is no longer a photographic stock portrait: face, fur, hands, seals and ice are all in visible, broad oil brushwork. It is dressed in black (c03): a heavy, fully opaque black fur-and-skin parka with a wide black fur-ruffed hood and black trousers. Nothing reads as a friar robe, Grim Reaper or Ringwraith. Two arms, each ending in an open, offering, palm-up hand. The near hand is large, foreshortened and painted with rough, chunky strokes, but it is anatomically sound: the thumb is at the outer edge and four curled fingers face the viewer. The far hand has the thumb raised and four fingers. Two trouser legs descend into the dark, and one is partly hidden by the nearest seal. There are no extra limbs, horns, fins or glowing eyes. He hangs upright and unmoving in deep water inside the iceberg he rules (lives in water, c03; inside icebergs and glaciers, c01/c02). There are no breath bubbles and no swimming action, so he reads as at home where no person could be, not as a man swimming. Three anatomically normal seals rise from the black depths past his open palms toward the light. Each has two fore-flippers, whiskers, and hind flippers where visible. This shows the seals being offered (c03) and the hunters being led to them (c01/c04). The ice walls stay still: no ice or water magic, no aura, and no light coming from the spirit. The scene is low-key, deep blue-black and walnut. The one light source is a single daylight shaft from a small, distant opening at upper right, which lights one side of his face, both hands and the edges of the seals. There is no sunny cyan scene, blue sky or cloud puffs. Two tiny Inuit hunters stand on a solid ice ledge at the opening, entirely out of the water. They wear fur-ruffed hooded parkas; one holds a harpoon, and a skin kayak lies on the ice. They have no faces or knitted caps and stay secondary. The extreme low, close, foreshortened camera puts the looming head at the top of the frame, with an offering hand reaching at the viewer. At 200px it reads as a towering, solemn guardian in the dark heart of the ice, releasing seals up a shaft of light: awe-inspiring and benevolent (§6.5), not sinister, cute or a tourism photo. The face is a dignified, realistic Inuit face, with no caricature and no invented sacred emblems or tattoos. No text, signature, border or borrowed film, game or anime design. Minor issues that are not blocking: the face reads as mature and weathered rather than strictly 'ageless', and the warm light on the face is slightly warmer than the white shaft.
